notes_for_editor: No source gives the year the lookout was removed; Oregon Lookouts lists it as 'Removed' after its 1964 entries, undated. The register says 'used for emergency in 1971' while firelookout.com says 'Emergency 1971'; read here as emergency use. The 1953 lease and 1954 build are from the Central Oregon District annual report quoted on Oregon Lookouts. Register photos (1954, 1959, courtesy Howard Verschoor collection) not used because licence was not verified. Staffing as_of 1964 is the last dated record, not a current status.
